en: Daniel 1

zh: 但以理在尼布甲尼撒的宮廷裏

p.src: 1  In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.

ja: ネブカドネザルがエルサレムに攻めて
en: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.
u.src: 1  In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.

p.src: 2  The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the vessels of the house of God; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god. He brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

ja: された。ネブカドネザルはそれらをシンアルの
en: The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the vessels of the house of God; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god. He brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.
u.src: 2  The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the vessels of the house of God; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god. He brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

ja:
1:2 「主」と訳された言葉は「アドナイ」である。
1:2 「神」と訳されたヘブル語は「אֱלֹהִים」（エロヒム）である。
en:
1:2 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”
1:2 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).

p.src: 3  The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:

en: The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:
u.src: 3  The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:

en: 1:3 or, seed

p.src: 4  youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.

ja: たちであった。アシュペナズは
en: youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.
u.src: 4  youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.

p.src: 5  The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.

en: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.
u.src: 5  The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.

p.src: 6  Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

ja: には、ユダの子らであるダニエル、ハナニヤ、ミシャエル、アザリヤがいた。
en: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
u.src: 6  Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

p.src: 7  The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.

ja: えた。ダニエルにはベルテシャツァル、ハナニヤにはシャデラク、ミシャエルにはメシャク、アザリヤにはアベデ・ネゴという
en: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.
u.src: 7  The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.

p.src: 8  But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

en: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
u.src: 8  But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

p.src: 9  Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.

ja: から好意とあわれみを
en: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.
u.src: 9  Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.

p.src: 10  The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”

ja: たちよりも悪いのをご覧になれば、あなたがたのせいで
en: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”
u.src: 10  The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”

p.src: 11  Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

ja: がダニエル、ハナニヤ、ミシャエル、アザリヤの
en: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
u.src: 11  Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

p.src: 12  “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.

ja: あなたのしもべたちを
en: “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.
u.src: 12  “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.

p.src: 13  Then let our faces be examined before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s delicacies; and as you see, deal with your servants.”

ja: べてください。そして、あなたがご覧になったとおりに、しもべたちを
en: Then let our faces be examined before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s delicacies; and as you see, deal with your servants.”
u.src: 13  Then let our faces be examined before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s delicacies; and as you see, deal with your servants.”

p.src: 14  So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.

en: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.
u.src: 14  So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.

p.src: 15  At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king’s delicacies.

en: At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king’s delicacies.
u.src: 15  At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king’s delicacies.

p.src: 16  So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.

ja: らに与えられていたごちそうとぶどう
en: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.
u.src: 16  So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.

p.src: 17  Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

ja: えられた。またダニエルには、あらゆる
en: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
u.src: 17  Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

p.src: 18  At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

ja: らをネブカドネザルの
en: At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
u.src: 18  At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

p.src: 19  The king talked with them; and among them all was found no one like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. Therefore they stood before the king.

ja: らと話してみると、そのすべての者の
で、ダニエル、ハナニヤ、ミシャエル、アザリヤに
en: The king talked with them; and among them all was found no one like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. Therefore they stood before the king.
u.src: 19  The king talked with them; and among them all was found no one like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. Therefore they stood before the king.

p.src: 20  In every matter of wisdom and understanding concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters who were in all his realm.

en: In every matter of wisdom and understanding concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters who were in all his realm.

p.src: 21  Daniel continued even to the first year of King Cyrus.
